purpose: Visual-judgment fixtures for DESIGN_REVIEWER and PACK_REVIEWER evaluation. These fixtures test whether a fresh visual reviewer can detect known banner-quality problems from rendered artifacts without reading the expected findings first.

fixture_recipe.hero: high-luminance photographic texture behind headline slot

expected_findings.evidence: Headline crosses bright and dark local regions; portions lose legibility at actual size.
expected_findings.recommended_fix: Create a controlled copy-safe tonal zone using crop, scrim or plate before changing the concept.

expected_findings.evidence: Logo becomes the largest/highest-contrast AOI and competes with the proposition.
expected_findings.recommended_fix: Reduce logo scale/contrast while preserving clearspace and brand recognizability.

cases.name: Hero focal crop damages product comprehension

expected_findings.evidence: The crop removes an essential identifying part of the product, weakening comprehension.
expected_findings.recommended_fix: Move the focal point or use a different crop/asset for the narrow family.

cases.name: Micro banner carries large-format information density

expected_findings.evidence: Too many independent AOIs/copy levels compete within 50px height and require tiny text.
expected_findings.recommended_fix: Preserve proposition + CTA + brand; remove secondary proof/support and adapt the concept rather than shrink everything.

must_not_claim: a fixed universal fill percentage was exceeded

cases.name: Decorative lighting steals focal priority

expected_findings.evidence: The brightest region is disconnected from the hero, proposition and CTA, pulling attention into empty decoration.
expected_findings.recommended_fix: Reduce/move the light so it supports product separation or the intended scan path.

must_not_claim: the brightest pixel must always be the CTA

cases.name: Cross-size campaign design drift

expected_findings.evidence: One format no longer appears to belong to the same frozen campaign identity despite carrying the same concept.
expected_findings.recommended_fix: Restore approved typography/CTA/color/logo tokens while keeping the family-specific composition.

must_not_claim: all sizes must use identical geometry
